mclr.note: Official MCLR histories as published by each bank, copied without rounding or gap-filling. Rates are percent per annum. A blank cell means the bank published no rate for that tenor on that date. HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Axis Bank publish no official MCLR history, so their loans carry forward the last known rate, labelled Estimated (B-07, 22 Nov 2026).

repo.note: Each change in the RBI policy repo rate from the rate in force on 1 Oct 2019 (when external-benchmark-linked home loans began), as announced in the RBI's monetary policy resolutions and Governor's statements. Dates are announcement dates; the releases state the change takes effect immediately. Used for repo-linked loans (A-05, B-03).
